svg.aria-label: Four panels joined by arrows. The GPU: a grid of identical streaming multiprocessors, SMs; an H100 has 132 and the Jetson Orin NX has 8. One SM: four schedulers, each looking after its own warps. One warp: 32 threads that carry out each instruction together. One thread: its own registers r0, r1 and r2, holding a[i], b[i] and their sum.
svg.text: From the whole GPU to one thread
Each panel enlarges one part of the panel before it.
H100: 132 SMs. Jetson Orin NX: 8 SMs.
each scheduler looks after its own warps
its own registers hold r0, r1, r2
